title: Backed by $80 Million, Alta is Building the Infrastructure to Bring Global Banking Onchain
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – San Francisco, CA, USA, November 10th, 2026] New funding will advance institutional-grade blockchain infrastructure built for privacy, compliance, and global connectivity Alta, a financial infrastructure company building the foundation for the next generation of global finance, today announced it has raised $80 million in total funding, including a $47.5 million Series A […]
